summary: Iteration 33: Full backend + frontend coverage of new Forms endpoints (PUT /forms/{id}, POST send-email, POST to-folder) and Patient Folders drag-drop/preview. All 10 pytest tests PASSED and all 6 frontend flows verified against the deployed URL.
critical_code_review_comments: forms.py line 273 owner check: `existing.get('created_by') not in (user['name'], None)` — allows anyone to edit forms with no `created_by` (legacy nulls). Intentional migration handling; consider tightening after backfill.

PatientFolders.js drag-drop overlay is triggered via drag events — could not simulate OS-level drag-drop in Playwright, but file-input upload path (folder-upload-input) verified present and functional.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. All TEST_ forms and folder_items created during tests were cleaned. DB ends at 27 forms, 1 patient, 0 TEST_ leftovers (verified via direct Mongo check).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var when invoked from /app: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://veteran-care-portal.preview.emergentagent.com pytest backend/tests/test_iteration_33.py`. FormInput.fields is a dict (not list) — do not send empty [] or you get 422. Folder items are read via GET /api/folders/{patient_id} → .items[] and deleted via DELETE /api/folders/items/{item_id}. Email is intentionally not configured; send-email returns {sent:false, configured:false} and the UI shows an info toast 'Email is not set up yet'.
verified_flows: Create form with empty recipient_email (frontend sends null) — 200 OK, no 422
POST /forms/{id}/send-email with valid email → 200 {sent:false, configured:false} (creds empty by design)
POST /forms/{id}/to-folder for field-based form → PDF item appears in folder (source=upload, content_type=application/pdf)
POST /forms/{id}/to-folder for uploaded-attachment form → file item appears in folder (source=form)
Frontend: open-form-<id> opens form-edit-modal; fm-title/fm-recipient editable; fm-save-btn persists
Frontend: fm-email-btn opens email-modal; send-email-btn triggers 'Email is not set up yet' toast (no crash)
Frontend: to-folder-<id> opens folder-move-modal; selecting patient + confirm-to-folder-btn shows 'Moved to' toast
Frontend: folder-preview-<id> opens folder-preview-modal with <iframe> for PDF items
Frontend: folder-upload-input present (file-input upload path). Drag-drop overlay markup present but OS drag not simulable in Playwright.
Frontend: Bilingual toggle EN↔ES relabels buttons (verified 'New Form' → 'Nuevo Formulario')
